Sub: Depression over southeast Uttar Pradesh  weakened into a Well Marked Low 
Pressure Area over central parts of Uttar Pradesh 
Depression over southeast Uttar Pradesh  moved north-northwestwards and weakened 
into a Well Marked Low Pressure area over central parts of Uttar Pradesh at 0530 hrs IST 
of today, the 27th September 2026. 
It is very likely to move north-northwestwards across Uttar Pradesh and weaken gradually 
into a Low Pressure Area during next 12 hours. 
The system is under continuous surveillance by Doppler Weather Radar at Lucknow. 
 
Warnings: 
(i) Rainfall Warning: 
East Uttar Pradesh:  Light to moderate rainfall at most places with  Heavy rainfall at isolated 
places on 27th September. 
West Uttar Pradesh: Light to moderate rainfall at most places with heavy to very heavy rainfall 
at isolated places on 27th September. 
Himachal Pradesh: Light to moderate rainfall at most places with heavy to very heavy rainfall 
at isolated places on 27th September. 
Uttarakhand: Light to moderate rainfall at most places with heavy to very heavy rainfall at a few 
places and extremely heavy rainfall at isolated places is very likely on 27th and heavy rainfall at 
isolated places on 28th September. 
(ii) Wind warning: 
Squally wind with speed reaching 30-40 kmph gusting to 50 kmph is likely to prevail over north 
Uttar Pradesh &  adjoining areas of Uttarakhand on  27th September and decrease gradually 
thereafter. 
India Meteorological Department 
 (Ministry of Earth Sciences) 
 

(iii) Impact expected (Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand and Himachal Pradesh  for heavy rainfall): 
❖ Breaking of tree branches, uprooting of small trees like banana, papaya, drum sticks. 
❖ Strong wind and rain may damage plantation, horticulture and standing crops. 
❖ Partial damage to vulnerable structures due to strong wind & heavy rain. 
❖ Minor damage to kutcha houses/walls, huts and roads due to heavy rain. 
❖ Road and rail traffic may be affected due to heavy rain and squally winds. 
❖ There could be localised landslides, mudslides, landslips  in hilly areas and water logging, 
inundation and flooding over low-lying areas. 
❖ Occasional reduction in visibility due to heavy rainfall. 
❖ Helicopter services may get affected. 
Action suggested: 
❖ People are advised to keep a watch on the weather for worsening conditions and be ready to 
move to safer places accordingly. People may stay in safe places. 
❖ Surface transport, Tourism and recreational activities to be regulated. 
❖ Helicopter services to be regulated. 
❖ Take safe shelters; do not take shelter under trees, as there could be lightning. 
❖ In case of expected lightning, unplug electrical/ electronic appliances, immediately, get out of 
water bodies and keep away from all the objects that conduct electricity. 
 
This is the last update about the system. However, regular bulletins/messages regarding 
the remnant Well Marked Low Pressure Area will continue from National Weather 
Forecasting Centre/Regional Meteorological Centres/Meteorological Centres.
  
 
(DHARMA RAJU ) 
IMD, New Delhi
